summary: Large sealed bush car park, no buildings nearby, far corner backs onto forest.
reasons: Big sealed lot with plenty of room

drivers.seclusion: Bush on three sides; no buildings in the data or imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot off the main road, marked bays, no gate seen; room for many vans.
drivers.traffic: Main road passes about 60 m away; a van in the lot stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Busy with a market or event in the QLD image; cars and a van parked in Esri image.

flags: Traffic noise from the main road
Council signs (No Stopping, Bus Zone) apply to the road, not the lot
sun_shade: Open sun on the lot; bush shades the north edge from the north and east in the morning.
cannot_judge: Car park hours or on-site signs
Whether the lot is closed at night

best_section.where: North-east edge of the car park, backing onto bush, furthest from the main road
